sources.entry: Visual Paradigm - All-in-one UML, SysML, BPMN modeling platform.

summary.name: Visual Paradigm
summary.one_liner: Visual Paradigm is a commercial visual modeling platform covering UML, SysML, BPMN, enterprise architecture, agile management, code engineering, and AI-assisted diagram and document generation.
use_cases: Drawing UML, SysML, and BPMN diagrams
Generating class or sequence diagrams from text with AI
Agile backlog and user story planning
Generating code from or reverse engineering to diagrams
Running SWOT, PESTLE, and other strategy analyses
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a suite of modeling tools for visual modeling, code engineering, agile management, and enterprise architecture. Users can describe a system in text and have the AI engine generate class diagrams, flowcharts, and user stories. It lists editors for many UML diagram types, SysML, ArchiMate, BPMN, and C4 diagrams, plus code generation and reverse code-to-diagram features. It also includes agile tools such as Scrum boards, burndown charts, and Jira sync, along with strategy canvases (SWOT, PESTLE, Business Model Canvas) and a Unified Platform that gives access to desktop and web-based tools from one place. Version control features (commit, branching, conflict resolution) and team collaboration on diagrams are listed as well.
notable: AI generation of diagrams, user stories, and strategy analyses from text descriptions
Unified Platform with 100+ apps and a shared drive for desktop and browser work
Broad standards coverage including UML, SysML, ArchiMate, BPMN, and C4
Academic program offering free or discounted licenses to accredited institutions
caveats: Pricing details are not shown on the page; many AI and premium features are described without stated cost
Some listed features (such as premium scene transitions and certain AI tools) are described as premium or unspecified access
The listing says it is on macOS awesome-mac list, but the page text does not explicitly name macOS as a supported platform
